title: Cabinet approves Robotics and Physical AI Policy
date_basis: Both fetched reports explicitly date Tuesday's cabinet approval to 10 November 2026.
summary: Andhra Pradesh's cabinet approved its Robotics and Physical AI Policy, according to two same-day reports.
initiative: Andhra Pradesh Robotics and Physical AI Policy
limitations: Fresh cabinet reporting at the research cutoff; notification, policy text and implementation measures were not retrieved. Both accounts may rely on one cabinet briefing.

title: Cabinet approves Uttar Pradesh Artificial Intelligence Mission
date_basis: 10 October article says Cabinet approved it on Friday, which was 9 October 2026.
summary: Cabinet approved UP-AIM with an institutional structure, AI infrastructure and skilling plans, and proposed safeguards for high-impact government uses.
limitations: Cabinet approval verified from fetched reporting, not the underlying order. Startup, training and district-centre numbers are targets; proposed trust and assurance framework is not treated as an enacted regulatory instrument.

title: AI business allocation establishes departmental oversight role
date_basis: Policy note identifies G.O.(Ms).No.47, HRM(A), dated 5 August 2026; underlying order not independently fetched.
source_name: Government of Tamil Nadu, AI, IT and Digital Services Department
summary: Tamil Nadu's policy note attributes AI business allocation and departmental concurrence to G.O.47, within a government-wide AI assessment and rollout regime.
initiative: Tamil Nadu AI concurrence and oversight regime
limitations: Order date is reported by an official policy note; no independent legal-effect or implementation audit. The 2020 ethical policy itself predates the sample.

title: Odisha signs tripartite AI data-centre MoU with HCLTech and Sarvam
date_basis: Government and company releases explicitly date signing to 24 July 2026.
summary: Odisha, HCLTech and Sarvam signed an agreement to establish an AI data centre in the proposed Odisha Sovereign AI Park.
limitations: One tripartite agreement, separate from the HCLTech Global Technology Center MoU signed the same day. The planned ₹14,257 crore capital outlay includes unspecified state financial assistance; no completed facility or expenditure is verified. Relationship to the February Sarvam agreement is retained under the same initiative; do not add its capacity as completed infrastructure.

title: Odisha signs HCLTech agreement for AI-led Global Technology Center
date_basis: Government and company releases explicitly date signing to 24 July 2026.
summary: Odisha and HCLTech signed an agreement for a Bhubaneswar Global Technology Center to develop and deliver AI-led digital solutions.
limitations: Bilateral agreement distinct from the same-day tripartite AI data-centre MoU. The ₹730 crore investment, capacity for 5,000 people and 2028 operating target are plans, not verified expenditure, employment or operations. The complementary centres share the Odisha sovereign AI infrastructure initiative.

title: Assam commissions government-owned GPU cluster for AI services
date_basis: 31 July report says installation was around two weeks earlier and applications were already running. Month precision is supported; exact commissioning day is unknown.
summary: The state reported an eight-node L40S GPU cluster at its data centre already supporting AI applications, including an e-Office document assistant.
limitations: Operational status is reported through named officials, not independently benchmarked. Eight nodes must not be converted into an assumed GPU count, and no accuracy or usage performance is established.

title: Government issues Maharashtra AI Policy 2026 resolution
date_basis: Header of official Government Resolution POLICY-2026/C.R.64/IT states 06 May 2026; preferred to conflicting index metadata.
source_name: Electronics, Information Technology and Artificial Intelligence Department, Government of Maharashtra
summary: The state issued the formal Government Resolution adopting its AI Policy 2026, with infrastructure, workforce, innovation and responsible-use provisions.
limitations: Official policy index lists 16/05/2026, but linked document header says 06 May 2026. PDF date retained; discrepancy disclosed. Formal adoption does not establish programme execution.

title: Cabinet approves Maharashtra AI Policy 2026
date_basis: Akashvani bulletin dated 30 April says cabinet action occurred yesterday.
summary: The cabinet approved a statewide AI policy proposing an AI Mission, compute and innovation infrastructure, skilling and startup support.
limitations: Investment and employment numbers in coverage are future targets. This cabinet milestone is distinct from the subsequent Government Resolution.

title: Rajasthan issues GPU server tender for state data centre
date_basis: Official RFP reference and document-availability start both date March 24 2026.
summary: RISL invited bids for GPU servers supporting AI workloads at the state data centre, with an estimated procurement value of ₹9 crore including taxes.
limitations: Tender value is an estimate, not spending or an awarded contract. A revised RFP retains the original notice date; later bid-deadline extensions are not new policy events.

title: Finance Department issues AI procurement-platform RFI
date_basis: Primary RFI FD/PROCUREMENT/AI/2026/01 explicitly dated 15 March 2026.
source_name: Assam Society for Comprehensive Financial Management System, Finance Department
summary: Assam's Finance Department sought market input on an AI-assisted platform for procurement-document preparation, compliance checks and analytics.
limitations: This is a concrete pre-procurement action, not a selected supplier, awarded contract, deployed platform or delegated automated procurement decision. Classified by intended public-sector use; stage remains announced.

title: Responsible AI committee holds its first meeting
date_basis: Dated article explicitly says first meeting took place today.
summary: A committee chaired by Kris Gopalakrishnan began work on a safe, transparent and accountable AI framework for state governance.
limitations: Date is the first meeting, not the unknown constituting-order date; a completed or binding AI policy is not established by these sources.

title: Odisha notifies rules for AI procurement and implementation
date_basis: Notification No.1547 is dated 12 March 2026; Gazette No.1300 carrying it is dated 30 March. Event is issuance, publication_date is Gazette date.
source_name: Government of Odisha, Electronics & IT Department
summary: The E&IT Department issued operational rules covering AI project selection, procurement, institutional roles and data governance.
limitations: Approved denotes a formal departmental notification, not a Cabinet vote. Document prescribes future taskforce, cell and centre responsibilities; issuing rules does not prove compliance, operational institutions or effective safeguards.

title: Gujarat establishes AI Implementation Cell
date_basis: Approved-date footer of DST circular reads 10 March 2026.
source_name: Department of Science and Technology, Government of Gujarat
summary: Gujarat created an AI Implementation Cell under its science and technology department, headed by Gujarat Informatics Limited’s managing director, to coordinate the action plan.
limitations: Circular establishes institutional authority and composition; it does not provide staffing, execution or impact evidence.

title: Cabinet approves IT policy with Kerala AI Mission provisions
date_basis: Dated report explicitly identifies cabinet approval on Friday 20 February.
source_name: Government of Kerala, hosted by KFON
summary: Kerala approved IT Policy 2026, whose AI mission section sets objectives for ethical governance, public-sector applications and workforce development.
limitations: The policy's ten-year mission, 50 solutions and 100,000 professionals are goals. Relationship to the earlier K-AI programme is not sufficiently defined to count them as unrelated missions.

title: Chief minister announces planned State AI Mission
date_basis: Pioneer report dated Saturday February 21 says the chief minister announced it Friday.
summary: The chief minister announced plans for a State AI Mission supporting public services and agriculture, education and healthcare, including future use at Simhastha 2028.
limitations: Future intent is retained as announced; no final policy notification, approved mission budget or completed deployment is established by this report.

title: Gujarat approves AI Innovation Challenge funding and evaluation rules
date_basis: Official circular approved-date footer and electronic signature both date 13 February 2026.
source_name: Department of Science and Technology, Government of Gujarat
summary: The state formalised challenge evaluation and funding rules, with indicative PoC ceilings of ₹7.5 lakh or ₹10 lakh and staged disbursement tied to deployment and departmental acceptance.
limitations: These are per-use-case indicative ceilings, not a total budget or disbursement. Annexure dated 19 July 2025 is not the circular approval date. Production support remains conditional.

title: FY2026–27 budget proposes ₹225 crore for the AI Mission
date_basis: Budget document establishes amounts; fetched contemporaneous reporting expressly dates budget presentation to 11 February 2026.
source_name: Information & Public Relations Department, Uttar Pradesh
summary: The state budget provided ₹225 crore for the AI Mission and separately ₹32.82 crore for AI labs and a centre of excellence.
limitations: Budget presentation/provision is not proof of appropriation passage, release or expenditure. Do not add the ₹2,000 crore mission announcement to these annual provisions; ₹2,059 crore is the whole IT/electronics sector, not AI.

title: Odisha and Sarvam sign agreement for sovereign AI capacity
date_basis: Company's fetched 9 February release explicitly identifies signing on 6 February 2026.
summary: Odisha signed an MoU with Sarvam for AI computing capacity, including a planned 50 MW facility and applications suited to state industries and skills.
limitations: 50 MW is planned capacity. This earlier agreement is linked to later AI-park activity, so capacities and investment announcements must not be added as independent projects without project-level reconciliation.

title: Telangana signs Blaize MoU for AI and semiconductor collaboration
date_basis: Official release dated 21 January 2026 describes the finalized MoU; updated 22 January.
summary: At Davos, Telangana signed an MoU with Blaize covering advanced AI capabilities, R&D expansion support and exploration of sectoral applications.
limitations: Potential healthcare, manufacturing and energy pilots were discussed, not reported as implemented. Existing Hyderabad R&D activity is not counted as a new state deployment.

title: Invest UP and AM Group sign proposed 1 GW AI-compute hub MoU
date_basis: Both government and company releases explicitly date the Davos signing 20 January 2026.
source_name: Invest UP, Government of Uttar Pradesh
summary: Invest UP and AM Group signed an agreement for a proposed 1 GW AI-compute hub in Greater Noida.
initiative: AM Group Greater Noida AI compute hub
limitations: Official schedules conflict: Invest UP targets full capacity by 2028; AM Group says first capacity 2028 and full 1 GW by 2030. Planned ~$25 billion investment is a partner commitment, not state spending or completed capacity.

title: Madhya Pradesh signs BHASHINI multilingual governance agreement
date_basis: Dedicated PIB release confirms same-day signing during the January 15 conference.
source_name: Press Information Bureau, Digital India BHASHINI Division
summary: The state and Digital India BHASHINI Division agreed to integrate translation and AI language tools into government platforms to widen access across Indian languages.
limitations: The MoU enables future integration. It does not verify that all platforms or services were already available in multiple languages.

summary: IndiaAI Mission and Madhya Pradesh signed an agreement to support 30 Data and AI Labs through the state technical education, skills and employment department.
initiative: Madhya Pradesh IndiaAI Data and AI Labs
limitations: 30 is the planned state allocation under this agreement, not a verified number of operating labs. The national 570-lab target is not counted as MP activity.

title: MPSeDC signs nasscom agreement for AI Centre of Excellence

summary: MPSeDC and nasscom signed an agreement to establish an AI Centre of Excellence supporting public-sector adoption, startup development, training and research.
initiative: Madhya Pradesh nasscom AI Centre of Excellence
limitations: January 22 is the agency post date, not signing date. Agreement does not prove the centre was staffed or opened.

date_basis: Official expression-of-interest header and notice dated 13 January 2026.
source_name: Department of IT and Communication, Rajasthan
summary: The IT department issued a call for interested bidders to upgrade its existing state data centre for intensive AI workloads and associated power and cooling requirements.
limitations: The document labels itself a draft expression of interest and says it is not an agreement. It establishes a planning step, not a contract award or operational capacity.

date_basis: Official release Posted On 12 January 2026 describes that day's announcement.
source_name: Press Information Bureau, Ministry of Electronics & IT
summary: The Chief Minister announced a state AI Mission at Lucknow's regional AI conference, with an approximately ₹2,000 crore programme described in the release.
limitations: ₹2,000 crore is the announcement's programme-scale figure, not evidence of annual appropriation or expenditure. Later annual budget provision and Cabinet approval are separate milestones.

title: Rajasthan launches AI ML Policy and state AI portal
date_basis: PIB release dated January 7 explicitly identifies conference and policy launch on January 6.
source_name: Press Information Bureau, Ministry of Electronics and IT
summary: Rajasthan publicly launched AI ML Policy 2026 and its AI portal at the regional AI conference in Jaipur.
limitations: Launch is a distinct milestone after cabinet approval, not proof every policy programme is running. The national one-million-learner programme at the event is excluded from Rajasthan-specific targets.

title: Rajasthan signs Google agreement for AI public-service pilots
date_basis: PIB explicitly dates the signing event to 6 January 2026; partner-specific scope is supplied by retrieved reporting.
source_name: Press Information Bureau, Ministry of Electronics and IT
summary: Rajasthan signed an MoU with Google for AI and ML pilots in health, agriculture, transport and citizen services, with advice on cloud and AI implementation.
limitations: Partner-specific scope is described in fetched reporting and signing is corroborated by PIB. The executed agreement and completed pilots were not retrieved.

title: Rajasthan signs IIT Delhi agreement for AI research and capacity
date_basis: PIB explicitly dates the signing event to 6 January 2026; partner-specific scope is supplied by retrieved reporting.
source_name: Press Information Bureau, Ministry of Electronics and IT
summary: Rajasthan signed an MoU with IIT Delhi covering AI research, skills, startup mentoring, hackathons and a proposed AI Centre of Excellence.
limitations: Partner-specific scope is described in fetched reporting and signing is corroborated by PIB. The agreement does not establish an operating centre or completed training.

date_basis: NLU Jodhpur explicitly states its bilateral MoU was signed and exchanged on 6 January 2026; its announcement was published 7 January.
summary: Rajasthan and NLU Jodhpur signed an agreement for legal and ethical AI policy advice, AI and law training, startup mentoring and research on privacy and accountability.
limitations: The university confirms execution and scope. Planned legal advice, training and research do not establish completed oversight assessments or legally binding AI rules.

title: Rajasthan cabinet approves AI ML Policy 2026
date_basis: CMO release explicitly dates Tuesday cabinet meeting 30 December 2025.
summary: The cabinet approved a policy for AI use in government, education and industry, including privacy, explainable decisions, departmental oversight and a proposed AI centre.
limitations: Approval precedes public launch on January 6. Policy safeguards are stated requirements, not independently verified enforcement.

title: Madhya Pradesh announces Knowledge and AI City in Bhopal

summary: The state announced a proposed Knowledge and AI City in Bhopal to bring together research, educational institutions, startups and computing infrastructure.
limitations: Exact announcement date relies on retrospective news. Reports describe 2,000 then 3,700 acres; no settled acreage or completed development is asserted. The two news reports share a quoted advocate and are not fully independent.

title: Assam signs Google Cloud AI-governance MoU
date_basis: Government signatory's public post says today, 11 November; newspaper describes Tuesday signing and was updated 12 November.
source_name: Gopinath Narayan, Principal Secretary, Government of Assam, public LinkedIn post
summary: Assam signed an MoU with Google Cloud for AI adoption in government and a planned AI centre of excellence, with Paradigm IT as implementation partner.
limitations: Public first-person official statement plus reporting establish signing, not the text of the executed agreement. Centre opening, specific enforceable safeguards and training outcomes remain unverified.

title: Odisha publishes AI Policy in the official Gazette
date_basis: Gazette No.4602 is dated 28 October 2025; underlying resolution is dated 18 June. Record tracks publication, not the earlier decision.
source_name: Government of Odisha, Electronics & IT Department
summary: The official Gazette published Odisha's AI Policy, whose text sets its operating period from the Gazette notification date.
limitations: Formal publication is a distinct milestone for the same policy, not a second AI programme. The policy's five-year commencement clause does not prove all institutions or safeguards are operational.

title: Minister announces Coimbatore AI Centre of Excellence under PPP model
date_basis: Article dates minister's announcement to Friday 17 October.
summary: Tamil Nadu's IT minister announced a planned AI Centre of Excellence in Coimbatore under a public–private partnership model.
limitations: Minister reported a recent government order; its date and text were not retrieved. Event date is public announcement, not approval.

title: UPDESCO and IndiaAI sign Data and AI Labs MoU

source_name: Rajya Sabha / Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
summary: UPDESCO and IndiaAI signed an agreement to establish AI/data-skills labs in government ITIs.
limitations: PIB also reports an MoU ceremony on 12 January 2026 without identifying whether it renewed or expanded the September instrument; not counted as a second signing. Lab totals vary by date/scope (49, 62, 64); no operational census inferred.

source_name: Government of Tamil Nadu, AI, IT and Digital Services Department
summary: TNAIM, StartupTN and the MSME Department conducted a challenge to develop AI tools for early identification of non-performing MSMEs.
limitations: Month-level date only; a challenge is not a production deployment and successful models or interventions were not verified.

title: Gujarat issues five-year AI implementation action plan

source_name: Department of Science and Technology, Government of Gujarat
summary: Gujarat adopted a six-pillar AI implementation roadmap for 2025–2030, spanning data, infrastructure, skills, research and use cases, startups, and safe and trusted AI.
limitations: 24 July is resolution date verified retrospectively; July 28 is news publication. Planned AI factories, training and mission are not treated as completed initiatives.

title: AI-linked Agritech Innovation Hub opens at SVPUAT Meerut
date_basis: PIB release Posted On 8 July 2025 says inaugurated today.
source_name: Press Information Bureau, Ministry of Education
summary: SVPUAT Meerut and IIT Ropar inaugurated an agritech hub linked to ANNAM.AI and signed an MoU for research and field deployment.
limitations: Included because SVPUAT is a state agricultural university and state ministers participated; central–state institutional collaboration, not a solely state-funded project. No farmer-impact measurement inferred.

title: TGDeX data and AI platform launches
date_basis: Contemporaneous report explicitly dates Wednesday's launch to 2 July; implementing partner confirms July 2025.
summary: The state launched TGDeX to provide datasets, AI models and development resources for public-sector innovation.
limitations: Dataset counts conflict: contemporary news says 500+ and an undated partner page says 1,000+ at launch. No harmonized inventory count or AI impact claim is inferred.

title: Cabinet approves MahaAgri-AI Policy 2025–2029
date_basis: Same-day cabinet approval bulletin dated 17 June 2025.
summary: MahaAgri-AI sets an agricultural AI roadmap spanning shared data infrastructure, innovation support and pilots, with an initial ₹500 crore allocation proposed in the policy.
limitations: The official policy calls ₹500 crore a proposed initial allocation; it is not a measure of spending. The policy’s planned platforms and centres are not counted as operational.

title: Kerala inaugurates K-AI governance initiative
date_basis: Official Kerala State IT Mission page explicitly supplies inauguration date.
summary: Kerala inaugurated K-AI to connect government departments, startups, researchers and experts developing AI solutions for public services.
limitations: Programme inauguration does not establish deployment of particular AI services; source publication date is not given.

title: Government signs NVIDIA MoU for proposed AI university
date_basis: Dated report describes the agreement and meeting on Friday 6 June.
summary: Andhra Pradesh and NVIDIA agreed to support a proposed AI university, engineering-student training, research infrastructure and startup participation.
limitations: The university remains proposed in the source. Training 10,000 students and helping up to 500 startups apply are targets, not verified outcomes.

title: Cabinet approves Odisha Artificial Intelligence Policy 2025
date_basis: Final clause of primary Gazette expressly records Cabinet approval on 28 May; same-day reporting corroborates it.
source_name: Government of Odisha, Electronics & IT Department
summary: Cabinet approved a state AI policy covering infrastructure, skills, energy and governance, with a planned AI Mission and coordinating bodies.
limitations: Approval is separate from the 18 June resolution and 28 October Gazette publication. Planned sectoral applications and coordinating bodies are not counted as completed deployment.

title: Chief Minister introduces AI anchor for Cabinet updates
date_basis: Fetched article and embedded public Chief Minister post both give 14 May 2025.
summary: The Chief Minister publicly introduced Ankita, an AI-generated Assamese-language presenter delivering updates from a Cabinet meeting.
limitations: Evidence establishes a public demonstration of government communication, not routine adoption, accuracy, audience reach or an independently verified service improvement.

title: AI Pragya skilling initiative launches
date_basis: Article body explicitly gives Friday, 9 May 2025; article publication was 10 May.
summary: The Chief Minister launched AI Pragya in Lucknow to expand AI and digital skills, with a stated target of training one million young people.
limitations: Programme launch does not establish training completion, learner outcomes or World Bank financing specifically earmarked for AI Pragya.

title: Government approves guidelines for AI-capable data-centre policy
date_basis: Date printed on G.O.Ms.No.12 and its annexure.
source_name: Government of Andhra Pradesh, ITE&C Department
summary: The state approved operating guidelines for its data-centre incentive policy, which explicitly seeks investment in AI-capable data infrastructure.
limitations: This is a wider data-centre policy with a substantive AI objective, not an AI-only programme. Earlier policy-order references conflict within the document; only the guidelines approval is dated here.

title: State begins AI governance workshop with Wadhwani

summary: Andhra Pradesh began an AI governance workshop for public officials, linking training to departmental project selection and proofs of concept.

limitations: Wadhwani's page republishes The Hindu and is not independent corroboration. Follow-on project targets are not completed applications.

title: BuildNow AI-assisted building approvals expand to HMDA

summary: Telangana extended its AI-assisted building-approval service from GHMC to the wider Hyderabad Metropolitan Development Authority region.

title: Odisha begins AI training workshop series for government officials
date_basis: Contemporaneous article explicitly says 16 April 2025; partner-hosted reprint published 21 April describes the previous Wednesday.
summary: The E&IT Department and Wadhwani Foundation held the first workshop in a planned series to train officials in AI and public-service applications.
limitations: This was structured government workforce training, not proof of deployed services. MoUs mentioned in remarks lack signing dates and are not counted as separate events; both reports may share release text.

title: Microsoft MoU proposes three AI centres for governance
date_basis: Hindustan Times report dated Wednesday 2 April says signing occurred Tuesday.
summary: Maharashtra signed an MoU with Microsoft for AI centres in Mumbai, Pune and Nagpur, covering geospatial analytics, forensic investigation and governance, plus staff training.
limitations: This records signing, not opening of all three centres. The agreement builds on existing MARVEL; do not count it as MARVEL’s first establishment.

title: Minister announces AI voice services for Mana Mitra
date_basis: Dated Assembly report identifies the minister's statement on Tuesday.
summary: Andhra Pradesh announced planned AI-enabled voice services and chatbot improvements for its Mana Mitra WhatsApp governance platform.
limitations: The 100-day target is prospective. Existing WhatsApp service use does not demonstrate deployment of the announced AI capability.

summary: Tamil Nadu proposed AI and other emerging-technology degrees plus shared centres of excellence in government engineering colleges at an estimated Rs 50 crore.

summary: The state and Microsoft signed an agreement for AI and advanced-technology training covering youth, teachers and public officials.
limitations: Training figures are commitments and target groups, not verified completions; overlapping participant categories should not be summed.

summary: The FY2025-26 budget proposed encouraging Assam Police to establish an AI-based anti-deepfake and cyber-surveillance lab.

date_basis: Budget paragraph 451; presentation date corroborated by contemporaneous reporting.

date_basis: Budget paragraph 34; presentation date corroborated by contemporaneous reporting.
summary: Proposed Digital Agricultural Service Centres would combine AI and geospatial tools to support farmers' crop decisions.

summary: The state’s science and technology department signed with IBM to develop a watsonx-based AI cluster offering financial institutions sandbox, proof-of-concept and training support.
limitations: Signing is not proof that the cluster is operational. This IBM agreement is distinct from the Microsoft centre agreement signed the same day.

title: Gujarat signs Microsoft MoU for GIFT City AI centre
date_basis: Same-day PTI report states Saturday signing; later inauguration report retrospectively identifies June 2024 agreement.
source_name: Hindustan Times / Press Trust of India
summary: Gujarat signed an MoU with Microsoft for an AI Centre of Excellence at GIFT City focused on machine learning, cognitive services and chatbots, alongside NASSCOM capacity collaboration.
initiative: GIFT City AI Centre of Excellence
limitations: Microsoft and NASSCOM signed separate commitments during one ceremony; capacity collaboration is retained in this ecosystem record rather than expanded into a third same-day row.

title: Class 7 AI curriculum announced for new school year
date_basis: IndiaAI announcement is dated 30 May and cites KITE; upcoming academic year begins 3 June.
source_name: Kerala Infrastructure and Technology for Education
summary: Kerala introduced AI learning in its revised Class 7 ICT textbook, including a computer-vision programming exercise.
limitations: Date is the public announcement, not an observed first classroom session. Four lakh students is intended reach, not a measured learning result.

title: KITE begins responsible AI training for schoolteachers
date_basis: On-site reporting specifies 2 May; annual report confirms May 2024 commencement.
source_name: Kerala Infrastructure and Technology for Education
summary: KITE began hands-on AI training for secondary teachers, covering classroom tools, privacy, algorithmic bias and responsible use.
limitations: The 80,000 figure is the programme target in the launch report. The annual report records 31,878 trained in FY2024-25; reporting periods and later cumulative claims differ.

title: Cabinet approves MARVEL AI policing initiative
date_basis: March 17 contemporary report documents approval; NITI retrospective corroborates establishment in March. Exact approval day not explicit in retrieved prose.
summary: The cabinet approved an AI policing special-purpose vehicle with IIM Nagpur and Pinaka Technologies, with a reported ₹23 crore proposed investment.
limitations: ₹23 crore is reported proposed investment, not audited expenditure. Later official feature reports usage but its impact claims are not independently evaluated. MARVEL acronym expansions vary across sources.

title: Budget announces Tamil Nadu Artificial Intelligence Mission
date_basis: Contemporaneous budget report and later government order explicitly date announcement.
summary: The state budget announced an AI mission to develop guidelines and utilisation protocols across education, industry, research and other sectors.
limitations: This is the 2024 budget milestone; the later order also references an earlier 2023–24 assembly announcement outside this sample.

title: Budget proposes an AI/ML administration unit
date_basis: Budget presentation date explicitly named in reporting.
summary: Karnataka's budget proposed an AI/ML unit to support technology-based administration and public-service delivery.
limitations: Announcement evidence only; no constituting order or launch date verified.

title: Budget proposes AI software within prison-security equipment package
date_basis: Budget presentation date explicitly named in reporting.
summary: The budget proposed AI software alongside baggage scanners and other prison equipment in a combined Rs 5 crore package.
limitations: Rs 5 crore is the combined equipment package, not an AI-only allocation; procurement and use not verified.

title: Assam budget proposes AI centre of excellence
date_basis: Official speech identifies FY2024-25; independently fetched PRS analysis dates its presentation 12 February 2024.
summary: The FY2024-25 budget proposed an Assam Centre for Excellence for AI alongside a state data-exchange platform.
limitations: No dedicated amount for the AI centre is specified in the cited passage. Adjacent ₹5 crore allocation is for the Gyan Dhara virtual-reality project and must not be attributed to AI. Proposal is not an opening.

title: Forest Department launches AI surveillance to prevent elephant collisions
date_basis: ETV article dated Saturday 10 February says launched Friday; BBC independently confirms February launch.
summary: Tamil Nadu launched AI-enabled elephant detection near Madukkarai railway tracks, with cameras and alerts to forest and railway officials.
limitations: Launch and physical deployment verified by reporting; no independent causal evaluation of prevented deaths. ETV extraction returned only headline, deck and date.

title: Maharashtra signs cross-sector AI partnership with Google
date_basis: Contemporaneous 8 February report and embedded dated Deputy CM post in PTI coverage.
summary: The state signed an MoU with Google covering AI applications in agriculture, healthcare, education and public services, alongside skilling and innovation support.
limitations: MoU commitments are not evidence of launched applications or completed training; planned CoE is kept within this announcement.

title: Technical education department signs IBM SkillsBuild MoU
date_basis: IBM release dateline says January 12 and today signed; webpage publication metadata says January 11.
summary: Gujarat’s Commissionerate of Technical Education partnered with IBM to support AI, generative AI and other emerging-technology skills through SkillsBuild.
limitations: Release display date and dateline conflict by one day. Signing follows explicit dateline, with uncertainty retained. No Gujarat-specific completion count is established.

title: RTGS reports AI search across government documents
date_basis: Operational status reported at 16 September 2025 collectors' conference; actual deployment date unspecified.
summary: An RTGS official reported an introduced AI-based search interface with voice features for government documents, including government orders.
limitations: Operational status is the official's reported claim; no service test, coverage audit or deployment date was verified. Inclusion reflects documented in-period operation, not a known launch.

title: State-backed AI data centre project announced near Indore
date_basis: RackBank release dated October 24 reports CM foundation stone and state incentives but omits precise ceremony and subsidy-approval dates.
summary: RackBank reported state electricity and investment-policy incentives for its AI data centre near Indore, alongside a foundation-stone ceremony involving the chief minister.
limitations: Included because explicit state support is reported, not simply because a private project is located in MP. No subsidy sanction order, disbursement, installed capacity or operational date independently verified.

title: State approves Sarvam AI package for government departments
date_basis: Retrieved report establishes approval by publication on 7 August 2026; exact GR approval date was not retrieved.
summary: Maharashtra approved a reported ₹11.26 crore two-year Sarvam AI package, including Indus for about 2,500 government users and speech and outreach tools.
limitations: Approval date remains unknown; 7 August is publication, not occurrence. Counterparty confirms approved deployment but provides no measured active-user count. Outlay is not actual expenditure.

title: Rajasthan opens draft AI policy for public consultation
date_basis: News published 14 July 2025 says draft was uploaded and stakeholder consultation held; exact upload date not established.
summary: The IT department invited feedback on its draft AI Policy 2025, covering government uses, skills, research and digital infrastructure.
limitations: This was a draft, not final adoption. Publication date is kept separate from unknown release date; some search snippets show July 15 while article footer says July 14.
